content: For future work, we may also consider experimenting with different forms of word embeddings, such as improved word vectors (IWV) which were suggested by Rezaeinia et al [10]. These IMV word embeddings are trained in a similar fashion to GloVe vectors, but also encode additional information about each word, like the word’s part of speech. For our model, we may consider encoding similar information in order for the generator to more easily learn common semantic patterns inherent to the marketing data being analyzed.
